changeSet.comment: Widen the physical relation evidence adapter contract without rewriting the already executed table-creation changeSet.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE modeling_physical_relation_observation DROP CONSTRAINT ck_physical_relation_observation; ALTER TABLE modeling_physical_relation_observation ADD CONSTRAINT ck_physical_relation_observation CHECK ( btrim(tenant_id) <> '' AND release_candidate_version > 0 AND model_revision > 0 AND implementation_revision > 0 AND observation_attempt > 0 AND model_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND implementation_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND scoped_bundle_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND credential_version_ref ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND expected_columns_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND adapter ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$' AND schema_name ~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,127}$' AND identifier ~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,127}$' AND expected_type IN ('TABLE', 'VIEW', 'MATERIALIZED_VIEW') AND column_count >= 0 AND ( ( relation_exists AND actual_type IN ('TABLE', 'VIEW', 'MATERIALIZED_VIEW') AND columns_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND actual_columns IS NOT NULL AND metadata_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND column_count > 0 ) OR ( NOT relation_exists AND actual_type IS NULL AND columns_checksum IS NULL AND actual_columns IS NULL AND metadata_checksum IS NULL AND column_count = 0 ) ) AND ( (verified AND relation_exists AND error_code IS NULL) OR ( NOT verified AND error_code IS NOT NULL AND btrim(error_code) <> '' ) ) );
